text:
alana: quick FYI — onboarding a HF checkpoint (huggingface/model-xyz) and ran into a token file mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json. fast tokenizer looked for 'special_tokens_map' but tokenizer_config.json only has 'bos_token'/'eos_token' fields. Model fails to load in the fast path and falls back to slow, which changes token ids and breaks our evals.
jon: ugh seen that before. do you have the file listing?
alana: pasted minimal repro below. path: ./artifacts/model-xyz/tokenizer.json vs tokenizer_config.json.
alana: ```
// tokenizer.json (excerpt)
"special_tokens_map": {"<s>": 1, "</s>": 2},
"model": {"vocab_size": 50257}
```
alana: ```
// tokenizer_config.json (excerpt)
"bos_token": "<s>",
"eos_token": "</s>",
"unk_token": "<unk>"
```
jon: the fast tokenizer expects the consolidated "special_tokens_map" in tokenizer.json, or at least matching names and ids. if tokenizer_config.json only lists names without ids, HF's fast loader may reconstruct differently.
sree: do we have a conversion step that merges these? I thought our HF-to-redwood script synthesizes tokenmap.json during conversion.
alana: conversion script (hf_to_redwood.py) currently does:
```python
# pseudo
config = load_json('tokenizer_config.json')
tokenizer = load_tokenizer('tokenizer.json')
# we were only copying names from tokenizer_config into config, not ids
```
alana: so if tokenizer.json is missing explicit special token entries (some exports don't include), we end up with mismatched ids.
dave: can we do a safe fallback: if special_tokens_map missing in tokenizer.json, try to map names -> ids by running vocab lookup on tokenizer object and writing a tokenmap artifact?
jon: yes, but must be deterministic — run through tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids on each special token name. if any name missing, emit an alert and fail conversion.
sree: agree. also we should add a lightweight CI check: when we ingest a new model, run a small roundtrip encoding test for the standard chat template. if outputs differ between fast and slow paths, fail onboarding.
alana: here's the quick patch I tested locally:
```bash
# in hf_to_redwood.py
if 'special_tokens_map' not in tokenizer_json:
  for tname in ['bos_token','eos_token','unk_token','pad_token','sep_token']:
    if tname in tokenizer_config:
      tid = tokenizer.token_to_id(tokenizer_config[tname])
      if tid is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing token {tokenizer_config[tname]} in vocab")
      tokenizer_json.setdefault('special_tokens_map', {})[tokenizer_config[tname]] = tid
  write_json('tokenizer.json', tokenizer_json)
```
dave: nice. any regression risk? if original tokenizer.json had a different mapping on purpose?
j on: (jon) if authors intentionally used different ids across files that's already malformed. but we should log a warning and attach a provenance note in the artifact manifest with original files.
token-bot: audit: new patch proposed for hf_to_redwood.py — adds special token id synthesis and encoding roundtrip check. CI test id #8912 queued. :gear:
sree: action items: 1) Alana open PR with patch + unit tests (including a toy HF export that lacks special_tokens_map). 2) Add CI roundtrip test to model-onboard pipeline (fast vs slow encoding for a small chat prompt). 3) Update docs: doc note about tokenizer artifacts required. 4) Add an ingestion warning when id mapping required.
alana: I'll open the PR today, assign to jon for review. PR will include failing example and the fix.
dave: also add a short troubleshooting blurb for support: "If chat responses shift tokens after conversion, check tokenizer special tokens parity and rerun mapping script."
j on: good. want to track in onboarding board — creating ticket INF-3124 now.
alana: thanks all. will post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
